Body.Content:
What and Why:

Android Agent Mode brings Copilot Agent Mode to Word on Android, enabling mobile users to work with Copilot in a more agentic, task-oriented experience from their Android devices. Users can ask Copilot to help draft, reason over, and refine Word content while staying productive on mobile.

Rollout Schedule:

General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out on late September 2026 and expect to complete by late September 2026.

Impact on Your Organization:

Who is affected:

  • Users with access to Copilot in Word on Android.
  • Organizations that enable Microsoft 365 Copilot experiences on Android devices.

Platforms/Services:

  • Microsoft Word for Android.
  • Microsoft 365 Copilot.

What will happen:

  • Copilot Agent Mode will become available in Word on Android.
  • Users can work with Copilot in a more task-oriented experience to help draft, reason over, and refine Word content on mobile devices.
  • The feature will roll out automatically during the scheduled rollout window.

Action Required/Recommendations:

  • No admin action is required.
  • Inform users and support teams that Copilot Agent Mode is coming to Word on Android.
  • Update mobile productivity, Word, or Microsoft 365 Copilot guidance if it describes Copilot experiences available on Android devices.
  • Review your organization’s existing Microsoft 365 Copilot and mobile app policies to ensure they align with intended user access.

Compliance considerations:

Does the change introduce or significantly modify AI/ML or agent capabilities that interact with or provide access to customer data?Yes. Copilot Agent Mode can help users draft, reason over, and refine Word content on Android devices.
Does the change provide end users any new way of interacting with generative AI?Yes. Users can interact with Copilot Agent Mode in Word on Android.
Does the change introduce or significantly modify any capability that enables users to automate workflows through AI or bot agents?Yes. This update brings an agentic Copilot mode to Word on Android for task-oriented assistance.
